# A build that imports several packages of one dependency needs every one of
# them generated, whichever of them it happened to load first.

env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod

go mod download example.com/generatedpkgs
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/one/one.gen.go
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/two/two.gen.go

go build ./both
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/one/one.gen.go
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/two/two.gen.go
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/one/one.gen.go
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/two/two.gen.go
go mod verify

# A package whose generator fails is recorded against that package alone. What
# the generator wrote before it failed never reaches the tree, and the packages
# generated before it keep what they generated.
! go build ./usebroken
stderr 'go: generating .*broken'
stderr 'broken on purpose'
stderr 'undefined: broken\.Name'
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/broken/broken.gen.go
! exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0.stage
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0.packages/broken/@failed
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/one/one.gen.go
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/two/two.gen.go
go build ./both

# A later package of the same module is generated into the tree the earlier ones
# already sit in.
go build ./usethree
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/three/three.gen.go
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/cache/generate/example.com/generatedpkgs@v1.0.0/one/one.gen.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.16

require example.com/generatedpkgs v1.0.0
-- both/both.go --
package both

import (
	"example.com/generatedpkgs/one"
	"example.com/generatedpkgs/two"
)

var Names = one.Name() + two.Name()
-- usebroken/usebroken.go --
package usebroken

import "example.com/generatedpkgs/broken"

var Name = broken.Name()
-- usethree/usethree.go --
package usethree

import "example.com/generatedpkgs/three"

var Name = three.Name()
